why_seated: The source named Q: 'Die — hypothetische — Quelle sei mit Q bezeichnet' (#1741 §6.5, L55).
research: The study of Q opened 2026-11-06 (working title 'I Know You Are, But What Am I?: Or, How a Completely Hypothetical, Uninspectable Text Is Granted Evidentiary Status Symmetrical to One That Is Inspectable Because It Exists — Revelation First'; Johannes Sigil and Rebekah Cranes, Provenance: Journal of Forensic Semiotics), the companion of Secondary Source (#1741), whose §6.5 reads Holtzmann, Wernle and Weiss by reference.
